text:
Maria N.: heads-up — our canary dashboards spiked after the last rollout. ingestion cost + telemetry cardinality went through the roof. looks like we started tagging metrics with user_id and request_id by accident
Vik P.: ugh. do we have an example of the metric label set?
Maria N.: yep, generated a metric like canary.latency{route=signup, user_id=12345, request_id=abc, cohort=new}. those two labels multiply cardinality.
Elaine S.: that explains the Prometheus/ingest cardinality. we should never emit user_id or request_id as metric labels.
Kai (SRE): agreed. two levers: stop emitting high-card labels, and add ingestion sampling on the metric exporter side. both needed ASAP.
Maria N.: what about canary-level breakdowns? product wants cohort + model_version split, but not per-user. can we do cohort hashes?
Vik P.: yes — use low-cardinality cohort ids (e.g., cohort=A/B/C) and a separate sampled event stream for debugging with user_id. keep metrics aggregated.
Elaine S.: proposed rules: metric_labels_allowed = [route, cohort, model_version, region]. disallow anything matching /(user|request)_id/.
Kai (SRE): +1. also suggest we convert per-request histograms to aggregated histograms on the agent via hdr buckets before sending. reduces point cardinality.
Maria N.: for immediate mitigation I can push a change to the telemetry agent to strip user/request labels and enable 0.1 sampling on debug events. anyone object?
Vik P.: go for it. also add a guard in rollout config validation that rejects high-card label templates. e.g., if a template contains "{user_id}" error out.
Elaine S.: can we have a console UX change too? when creating a canary, warn if the user adds a label with >1k unique values. show projected ingestion cost delta.
Kai (SRE): that would help product folks. we can compute a cheap estimate: projected_points = rps * windows * unique_labels_estimate. show delta in dollars.
Maria N.: example config snippet I plan to push to the agent before tomorrow's release:
```
telemetry: 
  metric_labels: [route, cohort, model_version] 
  event_sampling: 
    debug: 0.1 
    traces: 0.05 
  aggregate_histogram: true
```
Vik P.: looks good. add validation rule: if any label key matches /(user|request|email)/ then fail CI.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: telemetry-agent v1.4.2 -> canary hosts (5 nodes).
Maria N.: thanks. follow-ups: 1) add console warning prototype 2) rollout-config validator 3) doc note about telemetry cost. I'll open tickets.
Elaine S.: please tag me on the console warning ticket — want to design the wording and link to cost explainer.
Kai (SRE): I'll monitor ingestion after the deploy. if we still see spikes we throttle exporters and revert.
Vik P.: long-term: consider metric cardinality budget per-customer and per-route. automatic sampling when budget exceeded.
Maria N.: agreed — adding to roadmap item: telemetry cost controls + canary-safe defaults. thanks all :thumbsup:
